decisions.name: Qidong
decisions.reason: The official UN 2025 archive has distinct China Qidong rows: WUP10612 at rank 3235, 186620 persons and [26.7902999122816,112.09936209802]; previously investigated WUP11772 is at [31.8172210142948,121.661261170867], about 1082 km away. The prior packet explicitly covers Jiangsu Qidong. Shared romanized names do not make these the same settlement. Move the unchanged WUP10612 row to pending research. Its local name, cadastral custody, public geometry, and runtime qualification remain unverified.
